findings.claim: The warn-once latch lives in the daemon while delivery is per-CLI-process, so only the first attached app ever sees the warning: a second `portless app2 -- cmd` against the same daemon with the same unwritable hosts file prints nothing
findings.evidence: drove built dist/cli.js with PORTLESS_STATE_DIR=/tmp/pl364-a: proxy start --port 1355 --no-tls, then `app1 -- sleep 6` printed 'Could not write /etc/hosts...' on the CLI; then `app2 -- sleep 6` printed nothing, no marker written, only the daemon's original proxy.log line. app2.localhost is exactly the hostname that will not resolve

findings.claim: `portless alias` awaits the marker poll to its full 1500ms ceiling on every successful run, turning a ~0.2s command into ~1.6s; the code comment claims the poll never blocks the happy path, which is true only for the void'd callers
findings.evidence: PORTLESS_SYNC_HOSTS=0, proxy on 1356: `alias happyapp 4444` 1.596s total, `alias happyapp2 4445` 1.613s; the same command with a failure marker present returned in 0.212s
findings.layer: timeout hygiene on a one-shot command

findings.claim: The marker carries no freshness or ownership: it is never deleted when a later sync succeeds or when the daemon restarts, so an unconsumed marker makes an unrelated later command print a hosts-sync failure that is no longer true
findings.evidence: with PORTLESS_SYNC_HOSTS=0 (auto-sync entirely off for the run) and a marker file planted in the state dir, `alias staleapp 4446` printed 'Could not write /etc/hosts...'. Reachable without planting whenever a CLI is interrupted inside its 1500ms poll window, or a concurrent poll loses the race

findings.claim: `portless hosts --help` has a bolded Auto-sync section with behavior prose that still says only 'updates /etc/hosts by default. Disable with PORTLESS_SYNC_HOSTS=0' while README, SKILL, both docs pages and the main --help gained the failure-warning sentence
findings.evidence: gate.sh siblings flagged cli.ts on 7 untouched lines; the passage is cli.ts:2401-2404. House norm: cli.ts --help bolded feature sections are contract-carrying, not terse listings. Same class as the 2026-07-20 gate-miss ledger entry for this PR

issue_candidates.title: An all-routes-removed sync failure is silently swallowed

issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: deliberate trade-off of the warm-up-latch fix; cleanup failures are a separate surface

note: Round 4 on PR #367, after the two ctate findings of 2026-07-22 (case 367-daemon-emit-latch) were fixed across 6e93549 and 67572f9.
